entities.summary: Gentosha Inc. is a Japanese publisher, headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo. Gentosha publishes manga magazine Monthly Birz, web comic magazines GENZO, SPICA, Comic MAGNA, literary magazines Lynx, Papyrus, as well as business magazine GOETHE.
